# Freight and Customs Pricing

## Freight Rates
| Weight Range | Rate per Unit | Rate per 5% Increase |
| --- | --- | --- \
| 0-100 kg | $20.00 | $1.00 \
| 101-200 kg | $30.00 | $3.00 \
| 201-300 kg | $40.00 | $6.00 \
| 301-400 kg | $50.00 | $10.00 \
| 401-500 kg | $60.00 | $12.00 \
| 501+ kg | $70.00 | $14.00 \\ 
## Customs Rates
| Shipping Type | Customs Rate |
| --- | --- \
| Standard | 5% \
| Expedited | 10% \\ 
## Hazardous Surcharge
|  | Hazardous Surcharge Rate |
| --- | --- \
| Merchandise Value | 10% \\ 
## Example

### Non-Hazardous Standard Shipment

*   10 units at $120 each = $1200 merchandise value \
*   400 kg freight @ $50/5% increase per 100kg = $200 freight \
*   Insurance: 20% of $1200 = $240 \
*   Customs (5%): $60 \
*   Total Landed Cost: Merchandise + Freight + Insurance + Customs = $1600 \\ 
### Hazardous Shipment

*   10 units at $120 each = $1200 merchandise value \
*   400 kg freight @ $50/5% increase per 100kg = $200 freight \
*   Insurance: 20% of $1200 = $240 \
*   Customs (10%): $120 \
*   Hazardous Surcharge (10%): $120 \
*   Total Landed Cost: Merchandise + Freight + Insurance + Customs + Hazardous Surcharge = $1680 \\
